svg.aria-label: The outline-only mode, simple view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources, optional (stop); Structure architect (agent); Outline approval (stop) | paper: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist: each source confirmed by a live lookup (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1 (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge run, after the theme runs: removes the duplicates, assesses the sources the theme runs hand on, searches where the search themes meet, runs the quality gates, writes the one review (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Planner: outline and argument map (agent); Literature strategist: the sections with no source (agent, only when needed); Planner: assigns what was found (agent, only when needed); Outline approval (stop).

svg.text: Scripts and the session's own steps are left out. Not drawn because it is the same in every mode of paper: at every patch, a structural patch, a patch that does not apply or a failed script stops the run (a ruling of plan 5).
